profile.name: OpenBCI生物电采集板
profile.description: 这是一种多通道开源生物电信号采集板，主要用于采集脑电信号，并可提供辅助通道输入。设备可通过扩展模块增加通道数，适合用于脑机接口实验、神经信号记录、教学演示以及一般生理电信号采集。
profile.description_en: This is a multi-channel open-source biosensing board mainly used to acquire EEG signals, with additional auxiliary input channels. It can expand channel count with a daisy module and is commonly used for brain-computer interface experiments, neural signal recording, teaching, and general physiological signal acquisition.
